create.name: Jason Carlson
create.bio:
Jason Carlson is a Quantum-Touch practitioner and instructor working in the Dallas–Fort Worth area of Texas under the name Jason Carlson Ascension. Raised in Fort Worth in a Southern Baptist family, he later found a broader, interfaith spirituality at a Unity church, where in 2008 he joined a workshop on angel communication run by the healer Carol Lee. He went on to study energy healing with her, qualified as a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner in 2012, and spent several years as her assistant and business partner.

Since 2017 he has taught the two-day Quantum-Touch Level 1 workshop, and since 2023 the Level 4 workshop on heart energy, alongside his own Gathering of Angels course on connecting with one's guardian angel and spirit team. He offers one-to-one sessions that combine Quantum-Touch with angel-centred energy work, in person around Fort Worth or at a distance by Zoom or phone, and hosts a small online group meditation evening, the Celebration Circle. With Carol Lee he co-founded the Holistic Fair in Fort Worth in 2013 and still runs it as its director, giving short talks there himself.

courses.title: Private Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions that pair Quantum-Touch with angel-centred energy work, including meeting your guardian angel and learning to channel. Held in person in the Dallas–Fort Worth area or remotely by Zoom or phone; the fee depends on the scope of the session.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1: Becoming Energized
courses.description: The two-day foundation workshop of Quantum-Touch, teaching breathing, intention and body-awareness exercises for running life-force energy by hand and at a distance, plus work with the chakras. Jason teaches it on Zoom and in person; dates are announced on the page.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 4: Becoming Heart-Conscious
courses.description: A two-day follow-on workshop, formerly called Level 2, that works with heart energy, meditation, intuition and shifting beliefs. Level 1 is required first; dates are announced on the page.

courses.title: Gathering of Angels
courses.description: A two-day spiritual development workshop on sensing and communicating with your guardian angel and wider spirit team, with a guidebook. Taught by Jason on Zoom; dates are announced on the page.

courses.title: Celebration Circle
courses.description: An online group gathering on Zoom with guided meditations for clearing and manifesting, shared distant energy work and open spiritual conversation.
